stock.description: XXF Group Holdings Ltd. functions as an automotive retailer within the People's Republic of China, predominantly delivering vehicle finance leasing solutions through its proprietary sales network. The company's services encompass direct finance leases for non-luxury automobiles, along with operational leasing options and various other car-related support. Furthermore, it supplies information technology and insurance brokerage services. Founded in 2007, XXF Group is headquartered in Fuzhou, China.
